glossary.AAAA: a DNS record holding an IPv6 address
glossary.CIDR: Classless Inter-Domain Routing, a way of writing an IP address range such as 10.0.0.0/16
glossary.CNAME: a DNS record that points one name at another
glossary.HTML5: the current version of HTML, the language of web pages
glossary.ICMP: Internet Control Message Protocol (used by ping)
glossary.JSON: JavaScript Object Notation, a text format for data
glossary.OSI: the Open Systems Interconnection model of network layers
glossary.SKU: stock-keeping unit, the product tier Azure sells
glossary.SOA: a DNS start of authority record
glossary.SSH: Secure Shell, for logging in to a remote machine
glossary.TLS: Transport Layer Security, the encryption used by HTTPS
glossary.IP: Internet Protocol (as in an IP address)
glossary.SMB: Server Message Block, a file-sharing protocol
glossary.NFS: Network File System, a file-sharing protocol

checks.what: Four independent audits read every card against Microsoft's openly licensed Azure documentation, which the cards quote word for word as found by the card checker
checks.result: 2 wrong cards were fixed and rechecked (the port a Hybrid Connections endpoint may use, and how a public load balancer answers ping); 6 unsupported claims, 9 ambiguous cards, 9 unclear ones and 34 minor issues were also fixed, and 13 duplicates removed.
